## Xbox services (Microsoft GDK)
- Build for Windows → Player: C++ → **Xbox services**: the player's Xbox sign-in and gamertag, title-managed stats and leaderboards, rich presence, achievements (ID@Xbox titles) and Xbox cloud saves.
- Scripts use Xbox.signIn(), Xbox.setStat, Xbox.leaderboard, Xbox.setPresence, Xbox.unlock and Xbox.cloudSave / cloudLoad, in JavaScript, C# and GDScript. In the editor they run in a test mode, so you can try them before the game is set up in Partner Center.
- **Xbox cloud saves** keeps the game's localStorage in the player's Xbox cloud, so progress follows them to another PC.
- You need the free Microsoft GDK on your PC (github.com/microsoft/GDK, or winget install Microsoft.Gaming.GDK) and the Title ID, SCID and MSA App ID from Partner Center. The Xbox Creators Program is open to everyone; achievements need ID@Xbox. Ignite3D copies the GDK's runtime from your install and writes MicrosoftGame.config with the logos; it doesn't include any part of the GDK.

## Microsoft Store (GDK) packages
- New package type **Microsoft Store (GDK)**: an .msixvc made with your GDK's makepkg. Test packages install on this PC with one button (Developer Mode on); Store packages are encrypted for upload in Partner Center → Packages.
- Under the GDK's license, games that use it are published through the Microsoft Store.

## Controllers: Microsoft GameInput
- The C++ player reads controllers through GameInput on Windows (Xbox, PlayStation and more), and rumble now works there, including the Xbox controller's trigger rumble: Input.vibrate(strong, weak, ms, leftTrigger, rightTrigger).
- PCs without GameInput use the standard controller driver, as before.

## Also
- Claude's build_game can turn on Xbox services and make Microsoft Store (GDK) packages.

## Includes 2.23.1 and 2.23.2
- Controllers work in the Xbox app (on Xbox and PC), menus work with the controller, and the game fills the whole TV. Rebuild your Xbox app to get it.
- **window.IgniteHost** tells a Web Game where it runs ({ app: 'xbox-app', xbox: true } in the Xbox app, { app: 'preview', xbox: true } in Preview → Xbox).
- Claude's tools keep working while a Web Game plays in the editor.
- Linux and macOS get all of it with this update.
